svg.title: Model structure for the probe record
svg.desc: On the same Control Studio recording, the model with two stores follows the probe within 0.0024 degrees Celsius with a 1 second delay and lags of 5 and 2 seconds, while the one-store model needs a 2.4 second delay and a 5.7 second time constant and still misses by up to 0.143 degrees, outside the plus or minus 0.02 degree measurement bound. The water reference shows the probe's lag: 6 seconds after the step the water has risen 1.264 degrees and the probe 0.883.
svg.text: One store or two for the probe record
Control Studio recording · step 75 → 85 % at 5.1 s · both candidates fitted to the same record, bound ±0.02 °C · numbers answer the predictions
A: one store, L 2.4 s, τ 5.7 s
B: two stores, L 1 s, 5 s and 2 s
6 s after the step: probe +0.883 °C, water +1.264 °C
Probe first rises 2.5 s after the step, water 1.4 s; both end at 37.0 °C
A: errors up to 0.143 °C, outside the bound; B: 0.0024 °C
A imitates the slow start with a 2.4 s delay and a 5.7 s time constant
